description: Resolve whether a US civil aircraft N-number is active, reserved, deregistered, or unknown. Includes available registration and airworthiness status and cancellation history for the number. A reassigned number can have cancellations for different aircraft. Accepts "N12345" or "12345".

nNumber.description: US registration N-number to resolve. Accepts "N12345" or "12345" (leading N optional). Shape: 1–5 characters — a leading digit 1–9, then digits, optionally ending in 1–2 letters (I and O are unused).

name: faa_get_registration_status
